deadline.value: The department follows the Graduate School's deadlines, which are shown only in a split table.
deadline.quote: Deadlines for application to the ME Graduate Program follow those set by LSU's Pinkie Gordon Lane Graduate School

fee_waiver.value: The department does not give routine fee waivers; exceptions are possible for exceptional academic credentials.
fee_waiver.quote: As resources are limited, the department does not offer routine application fee waivers

also.quote: exceptions may be made for applicants that are able to document exceptional academic credentials

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required, but the department will consider them and highly encourages them.
gre_general.quote: Although GRE scores are not required, they will be considered in the review process and thus are highly encouraged

supervisor.value: Prospective students are strongly encouraged to contact professors; funded positions depend on a major professor.
supervisor.quote: Prospective students are strongly encouraged to reach out to professors whose research aligns with their interests

also.quote: it is imperative to reach out to professors before initiating the application process

funding.value: Acceptance does not ensure funding; the department offers a limited number of competitive nine-month PhD teaching fellowships.
funding.quote: For incoming PhD students, the department offers a limited number of nine-month teaching fellowships through a competitive selection process

also.quote: acceptance into the ME graduate program does not automatically ensure funding

entry_route.value: A PhD can start from a bachelor's degree (36 hours of coursework) or from a master's (18 hours of coursework).
entry_route.quote: directly from a Bachelor of Science degree or at least 18 hours of approved coursework from a Master of Science degree

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Department GRE rule is 'recommended' and the department writing sample is required, which is not a field here. The department decides on admissions about a month after the deadline.
